notes: Plain-text 10-K for fiscal 2004 with no table of contents, filed before Items 1A and 1B existed; the unnumbered 'Risk Factors' section stays in Item 1. Item 9B (added to the form in August 2004) has no heading and is absent. 'Item 4A. Executive Officers of the Company' is not a standard Item, so Item 4 ends at its heading and the executive officers section belongs to no Item, as in bench/holdout Ford 2010. Items 5 to 8 only incorporate portions of the annual report to shareholders, and Items 11 to 14 only incorporate the proxy statement. Item 10 adds its own code of ethics and audit committee financial expert text, so it is not marked. Item 4 ('No matters were submitted ...') and Item 9 ('None.') are answers and are not marked (the labelers differed on Item 9). Item 15 says Schedule II 'is included in Item 15(d)', and Schedule II is printed right after the 8-K list, so it stays in Item 15, which ends at SIGNATURES. The exhibit index and Exhibit 13.1 (portions of the 2004 annual report: MD&A, the auditors' report and the financial statements, about 2,100 lines) follow the signatures and belong to no Item.
